name: Carrot Salad
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: White balsalmic vinegar (or a mix of two parts red wine vinegar to one part balsamic vinegar)
Fresh greens like matzumi or baby Chinese mustard, or even Boston lettuce (optional)

steps: Julliene the carrots (or grate them if julienning is not feasible).
Coat with about 1–2 tbsp of almond oil.
Sprinkle generously with vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Add a hefty serving of pine nuts.

culture.text: A salad is a dish consisting of mixed ingredients, frequently vegetables. They are typically served chilled or at room temperature, though some can be served warm. Condiments called salad dressings, which exist in a variety of flavors, are usually used to make a salad.
